per_object_cap.stated: not applicable: an inference endpoint stores nothing for the caller

free_tier.stated: The OpenCode Console lists limited-time free models (for example DeepSeek V4.1 Flash Free) priced Free for input, output and cache; LongCat 2.5 Free is capped at 100 requests per day.

chaining: the limited-time status and the 100-per-day cap bind first

limits.value: LongCat 2.5 Free: 100 requests per day; other free models have no published number

identity_cost.detail: sign in to the OpenCode console; billing details and credits are added for paid use

reliability_note: free models are available for a limited time and some are region-blocked or retain data

evidence.proved: a free model on OpenCode is limited-time and capped at 100 requests per day
evidence.quote: LongCat 2.5 Free is free on OpenCode for a limited time, with a limit of 100 requests per day.

notes: Console is optional; a 4.6% + USD 0.31 fee applies to credit purchases.
